title: The California Undercurrent
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 monthly temperature, salinity, velocity, sea surface height and mixed-layer thickness for 2011-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), characterize the poleward California Undercurrent: its depth, strength, seasonal cycle and year-to-year changes, including during the 2014-2016 warm anomalies, and the water it carries.
